title: Do you get jealous easily?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What usually causes jealousy: insecurity, fear of loss, comparison, or something else?
Can a small amount of jealousy ever be healthy in a relationship?
How has social media changed the way people compare themselves with others?
Should someone tell their partner every time they feel jealous?
What is the difference between jealousy that can be discussed and jealousy that becomes controlling?
